title: CVE-2026-119977 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.
lines: WordPress WordPress Core: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability

WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.
